info.title: The Selling Partner API for tracking services provided by Amazon.
info.description: The Tracking Selling Partner API allows users to track shipments to and from Amazon-owned storage warehouses, fulfillment centers, and external warehouses.

get.summary: Get tracking information for the shipment.
get.description: Returns tracking information for a shipment.

GetShipmentTrackingResponse.description: Contains tracking details for a requested shipment.

trackingDetail.description: Current and historical tracking information for a shipment.

TrackingDetail.description: Tracking information for the shipment identifier.

identifier.description: The tracking identifier used to look up this shipment (for example, `id`, `acsin`, or `containerNumber`).

trackingUrl.description: The URL to view the shipment's tracking information.

trackingEstimates.description: A list of time-based estimated intervals for the shipment, such as estimated delivery date.

latestMilestone.description: The most recent milestone event for the shipment.

milestoneHistory.description: A chronological list of all milestone events for the shipment, from most recent to oldest.

TrackingIdentifier.description: The identifier to track a shipment.

id.description: A unique identifier generated by Amazon for the shipment tracking request.

acsin.description: The Air Cargo Shipment Identification Number.

containerNumber.description: The container number provided by the Logistics Service Provider.

houseBillOfLadingNumber.description: The House Bill of Lading (HBL) number.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number assigned by the carrier.

carrierCode.description: The carrier code associated with the carrier tracking number.

TrackingEstimate.description: A time-based estimate for the shipment, such as estimated delivery date.

type.description: The type of estimate. For example, `ESTIMATED_DELIVERY_DATE` or `ESTIMATED_TIME_OF_DEPARTURE`.

estimatedInterval.description: The estimated time window for this event, represented as a start and end time in UTC RFC 3339 date-time format.

lastUpdatedTime.description: The timestamp when this estimate was last modified, in UTC RFC 3339 date-time format.

BoundedInterval.description: A time interval defined by a start time and end time.

startTime.description: The inclusive start of the interval, in UTC RFC 3339 date-time format.

endTime.description: The inclusive end of the interval, in UTC RFC 3339 date-time format. Must not precede `startTime`.

Instant.description: A timestamp in UTC RFC 3339 date-time format.

TrackingMilestone.description: A single milestone event in a shipment's journey.

location.description: The location where this milestone occurred, if available. Contains an address with city, region, and country code.

occurredAt.description: The timestamp when this milestone occurred, in UTC RFC 3339 date-time format.

TrackingMilestoneStatus.description: The status codes and description of the milestone event.

code.description: A status code that identifies the milestone event (for example, `DELIVERED`, `CUSTOMS_CLEARED`, `DEPARTED`).

subCode.description: Status subcode that provides additional details about the milestone status. Valid values vary by milestone (for example, a `DELIVERED` milestone might include a `subCode` for the delivery location).

description.description: A human-readable explanation of the milestone event.

TrackingMilestoneLocation.description: The location where a tracking milestone occurred.

address.description: The physical address where the milestone occurred.

TrackingMilestoneAddress.description: The physical address of the location.

city.description: The city where the milestone occurred.

region.description: The state or region where the milestone occurred.

countryCode.description: The two-character country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (for example, `US`).
